$comment: The crosswalk as reviewers who teach to this curriculum wrote it, point by point, from the official text (scripts/curricula/apply-review.js --authored). `why` is the reviewer's reason; the registry's builder adds each row's grade and writes crosswalk.json.

K:position-words.why: K14.A: 'redeneert over meetkundige figuren en plaatsbepalingen' — op/onder/naast, links/rechts, binnen/buiten are the plaatsbepaling words of groep 1-2.

K:scene-search.why: Recognising a given shape among others comes before K14.A point a 'redeneren met en over eigenschappen van meetkundige figuren'; the child only recognises, it does not yet reason about properties.

K:compare-size-extremes.why: K11.A names 'lengte' as a grootheid but asks 'meet, redeneert en rekent met grootheden en bijpassende eenheden'; comparing by eye without a unit is the step before.

K:order-by-size.why: Seriating by size or height is direct comparison of 'lengte' without units, the precursor of K11.A ('grootheden en bijpassende eenheden').

K:patterns.why: K13.A point a: 'herkennen, beschrijven en voortzetten van patronen in rijen getallen en figuren' — extending and completing picture patterns is exactly this.

K:one-to-one.why: One-to-one correspondence is the idea under counting and under 'vergelijken' in K10.A point a, before numbers are used.

K:compare-groups.why: K10.A point a lists 'vergelijken' among the bewerkingen with gehele getallen; more/fewer/equal of two counted groups is that at kleuter level.

K:count-how-many.why: Counting a set and naming or writing the number to 20 is working with 'gehele getallen' (K10.A) at the level of groep 2.

K:subitize.why: Getalbeelden (dice, ten-frame) are the base on which 'memoriseren van getalrelaties, splitsingen van getallen tot 20' (K10.A point b) is built; not yet that memorisation.

K:conservation.why: Conservation of number is a condition for reasoning with gehele getallen (K10.A), not itself named in the wording.

K:count-out-n.why: Making a set of a given number is working with gehele getallen (K10.A) at groep-2 level.

K:shape-naming.why: K14.A point a: 'eigenschappen van meetkundige figuren en begrippen' — naming cirkel, vierkant, driehoek, rechthoek in any position is the begrippen part.

K:numeral-formation.why: K16.A point a: 'gebruiken van wiskundige symbolen, notaties en begrippen' — writing the cijfers is the first of these symbols.

K:colour-by-number.why: Reading a numeral key is recognising the symbols before using them as notation (K16.A point a 'gebruiken van wiskundige symbolen').

K:classify-count-kinds.why: Counting each kind is K10.A (gehele getallen); sorting a mixed set into kinds first is the step before 'invullen van tabellen bij data' (K12.A point a).

K:count-sides.why: The number of sides is an 'eigenschap van meetkundige figuren' (K14.A point a).

K:count-forward-missing.why: Filling the telrij to 10/20 is 'ordenen' of gehele getallen (K10.A point a).

K:dot-to-dot-sequence.why: Joining dots in counting order practises the order of the gehele getallen to 30 ('ordenen', K10.A point a).

K:one-more-one-less.why: One more / one less is the first 'optellen, aftrekken' and a getalrelatie (K10.A points a and b) at groep-2 level.

K:before-after-back.why: Buurgetallen and counting back are 'ordenen' of gehele getallen (K10.A point a).

K:ordinal-position.why: Rangtelwoorden (eerste … tiende) are whole numbers used for 'ordenen' (K10.A point a); the wording does not name them separately.

K:days-of-week.why: KD51: 'aanduidingen van tijd en tijdsindeling te hanteren' — the days of the week in order; for K11.A ('tijd' as grootheid with eenheden) it is the knowledge before measuring and calculating.

K:tally-marks.why: Turven is a notation and a second representation of a number (K16.A points a and e); it is also the recording technique that comes before tables and graphs of data (K12.A).

K:estimate.why: K10.A point d names 'schattend rekenen'; estimating a quantity and checking by counting is the idea before estimating in calculations.

K:heavy-light.why: K11.A names 'gewicht (massa)'; comparing heavier/lighter without a unit is the step before measuring with 'bijpassende eenheden'.

K:draw-shapes.why: Drawing a named shape from its sides and corners uses the 'eigenschappen van meetkundige figuren' (K14.A point a).

K:combine-groups.why: Putting two groups together and counting all is the idea of 'optellen' (K10.A point a) before its formal form with a sum; in Dutch schools formal sums start in groep 3.

K:take-away.why: Crossing out and counting what is left is the idea of 'aftrekken' (K10.A point a) before the formal sum.

K:count-on.why: Counting on from a known group (doortellen) is the strategy that leads to 'optellen' in K10.A point a; not yet the bewerking itself.

K:number-bonds-k.why: K10.A point b names it word for word: 'splitsingen van getallen tot 20'; these are the splitsingen to 10 (in Dutch schools groep 3 content).

K:compose-shapes.why: Building a figure from tangram pieces is reasoning with properties of figures and turning them (K14.A points a and e 'draaien').

K:mirror-image.why: K14.A point e names 'spiegelen' but asks the child to carry out transformations; recognising a mirror image is the step before.

K:odd-even-pairing.why: Even/oneven is an 'eigenschap van getallen' (K10.A point e); pairing objects with one left over is the idea before the number property.

K:teen-numbers.why: 13 = 10 + 3 is one of the 'splitsingen van getallen tot 20' (K10.A point b) and the structure of gehele getallen.

K:fact-fluency-colour-code.why: K10.A points a and b: 'optellen, aftrekken' and 'vlot en wendbaar toepassen' of memorised number facts to 20; in Dutch schools this is groep 3, not groep 2.

K:number-bonds-20.why: K10.A point b: 'memoriseren van … splitsingen van getallen tot 20' — exactly the range.

1:add-within-10-models.why: 'Optellen' with gehele getallen (K10.A point a) within 10-12 with a model, groep-3 level.

1:subtract-cross-out.why: 'Aftrekken' (K10.A point a) within 10 with a picture model.

1:write-the-equation.why: K15.B point b: 'weergeven van een situatie in wiskundetaal'; K16.A point a: 'gebruiken van wiskundige symbolen, notaties'; the content is optellen/aftrekken (K10.A).

1:patterns-missing.why: K13.A point a: 'herkennen … en voortzetten van patronen in rijen … figuren'.

1:sort-three-groups.why: Sorting into groups is ordering data before a table (K12.A point a 'invullen van tabellen bij data'); no data representation yet.

1:make-10.why: The vriendjes van 10 are 'splitsingen van getallen tot 20' to memorise (K10.A point b).

1:shape-attributes.why: Telling a real triangle from a not-real one by its defining attributes is 'redeneren met en over eigenschappen van meetkundige figuren' (K14.A point a).

1:ordinal-numbers.why: Rangtelwoorden order with whole numbers ('ordenen', K10.A point a); the wording does not name them separately.

1:number-line-placement.why: Placing numbers on the getallenlijn is 'vergelijken, ordenen' of gehele getallen (K10.A point a), to 50 in groep 3.

1:count-on-back-hops.why: Optellen/aftrekken (K10.A) shown as hops on a number line: K15.B point d 'gebruiken van abstracte modellen om rekenaanpakken te laten zien'.

1:word-problems.why: K15.A: 'lost wiskundige problemen en toepassings-problemen op', point c 'bewerken van de uitkomsten van berekeningen tot een oplossing'; the sums are K10.A within 20.

1:picture-graphs-sort-count.why: K12.A points a, c and d: 'invullen van tabellen bij data', graphical representations 'en daaruit conclusies trekken' (most, how many more).

1:doubles-halves.why: Dubbelen and halveren to 20 are 'getalrelaties' to memorise (K10.A point b).

1:odd-even-pairs.why: Even and oneven are 'eigenschappen van getallen' (K10.A point e), found here by fair sharing between two.

1:near-doubles.why: Bijna-dubbelen is a rekenwijze 'met eigenschappen van getallen en bewerkingen' and 'vlot en wendbaar toepassen' of known facts (K10.A points b and e).

1:add-three-addends.why: 'Optellen' with gehele getallen (K10.A point a), three addends.

1:fact-families.why: The four related sums use the inverse relation of optellen and aftrekken: 'eigenschappen van … bewerkingen' and 'getalrelaties' (K10.A points b and e).

1:missing-number-equations.why: Stipsommen within 10/20 are optellen/aftrekken with use of getalrelaties and splitsingen (K10.A points a and b).

1:true-false-equations.why: The meaning of the is-teken is K16.A point a 'gebruiken van wiskundige symbolen, notaties en begrippen'; checking each side is optellen/aftrekken (K10.A).

1:bar-model.why: The strookmodel is K15.B points a and d: 'schematisch weergeven van een situatie', 'gebruiken van abstracte modellen om … problemen op te lossen'; the missing part is a sum of K10.A.

1:tangram-compose.why: Composing figures from pieces: properties of figures and 'draaien' (K14.A points a and e).

1:days-months-seasons.why: KD51: 'aanduidingen van tijd en tijdsindeling te hanteren' (gisteren/vandaag/morgen, months, seasons); for K11.A ('tijd' with eenheden) this is the calendar knowledge before calculating with time.

1:days-months-seasons~season-wheel.why: Months and seasons are 'tijdsindeling' (KD51); KD46 names 'seizoenen' as a natuurverschijnsel but asks for the cause (position of the earth), which these sheets do not treat.

1:measure-length-units.why: K11.A: 'meet … met grootheden en bijpassende eenheden', point a 'lengte'; measuring with a natural unit and ordering by length is groep-3 measuring.

1:time-read.why: K11.A point a names 'tijd', point b 'meten met passende meetinstrumenten' (the clock); hele en halve uren, analog and digital.

1:fluency-within-20.why: K10.A points b and d: memorised number facts 'vlot en wendbaar toepassen' and 'hoofdrekenen'; the make-a-ten strategy uses the splitsingen.

1:number-walls.why: Optellen and aftrekken as inverse operations in a rekenmuur (K10.A points a and e).

1:check-answers.why: Checking worked sums is optellen/aftrekken plus K10.A point c 'reflecteren op de … uitvoering'.

1:bar-graphs.why: K12.A points c, d and e: 'maken van grafische representaties van data', interpreting them; 'diagrammen' (staafdiagram).

1:tens-and-ones.why: Tientallen and eenheden are the structure of the gehele getallen with which K10.A asks the child to reason and calculate; the wording does not name the positiestelsel separately.

1:number-words.why: Number words and numerals are two notations of the same number: K16.A points a and e ('relaties leggen tussen verschillende representaties'); the numbers to 100 are K10.A.

1:compare-order-two-digit.why: K10.A point a: 'vergelijken, ordenen'; the signs > < = are 'wiskundige symbolen' (K16.A point a).

1:hundreds-chart.why: Ordering the numbers to 100 (K10.A point a) and using the +1/+10 regularity: K13.A point a 'patronen in rijen getallen'.

1:one-ten-more-less.why: 1 and 10 more or less are getalrelaties and optellen/aftrekken with gehele getallen (K10.A points a and b).

1:number-of-the-day.why: K16.A point e: 'relaties leggen tussen verschillende representaties van een wiskundig concept' — one number as tens/ones, ten-frame, tally and words.

1:skip-counting.why: Counting in jumps of 2, 5 and 10 builds the 'tafels van vermenigvuldiging' (K10.A point b) and is 'voortzetten van patronen in rijen getallen' (K13.A point a).

1:time-set-hands.why: 'Tijd' in K11.A point a, with the clock as meetinstrument; quarter hours and five minutes are groep-4 content in Dutch schools.

1:coins.why: K11.A point a names 'geld'; counting and comparing amounts of coins is calculating with that grootheid.

1:open-number-line.why: The lege getallenlijn is the model 'om rekenaanpakken te laten zien' (K15.B point d) for optellen/aftrekken (K10.A).

1:mental-math-to-100.why: K10.A point d: 'hoofdrekenen' with gehele getallen; to 100 is groep-4 content in Dutch schools (judged by the skill line, not by the year).

1:bonds-to-100.why: Aanvullen tot 100 is a 'getalrelatie' to apply 'vlot en wendbaar' (K10.A point b); the memorised splitsingen themselves stop at 20 in the wording.

2:bundle-ten-ones.why: Bundling ten ones into a ten is the structure of the gehele getallen of K10.A.

2:hundreds-chart-moves.why: Moves of +1 and +10 on the honderdveld are optellen with gehele getallen and getalrelaties (K10.A points a and b).

2:odd-even.why: Even/oneven decided by the ones digit is 'rekenen met eigenschappen van getallen' (K10.A point e).

2:number-line-not-from-zero.why: Placing numbers on a part of the getallenlijn is 'vergelijken, ordenen' (K10.A point a).

2:2d-attributes.why: Sorting by number of sides uses 'eigenschappen van meetkundige figuren' (K14.A point a).

2:add-sub-within-100-practice.why: 'Optellen, aftrekken' with gehele getallen to 100 (K10.A point a), groep-4 range.

2:two-step-word-problems.why: K15.A: 'lost … toepassings-problemen op' with points a and c (an approach in two steps, turning results into a solution); the sums are K10.A within 100.

2:measure-with-ruler.why: K11.A point b: 'meten met passende meetinstrumenten' (lengte); K16.B point c: 'gebruiken van een instrument en de bijbehorende wiskundetaal'.

2:compare-lengths.why: K11.A: 'meet, redeneert en rekent met grootheden' — two lengths measured and their difference calculated; the ruler is the instrument of K16.B.

2:read-build-3-digit.why: Honderdtallen, tientallen and eenheden are the structure of the gehele getallen of K10.A; numbers to 1000 are groep-5 content in Dutch schools.

2:expanded-form-digit-value.why: The value of a digit is the base of reasoning with gehele getallen (K10.A); to 1000 is groep 5 in the Netherlands.

2:chart-within-1000.why: Ordering numbers to 1000 (K10.A point a) by the regularity of the chart: 'patronen in rijen getallen' (K13.A point a).

2:skip-count-5-10-100.why: Jumps of 5, 10 and 100: number relations and the base of the tafels (K10.A point b), and 'voortzetten van patronen in rijen getallen' (K13.A point a).

2:compare-order-3-digit.why: K10.A point a: 'vergelijken, ordenen'; < > = are 'wiskundige symbolen' (K16.A point a).

2:hundred-more-less.why: 100 more or less is optellen/aftrekken with the structure of gehele getallen (K10.A).

2:time-5-min-quarter.why: 'Tijd' in K11.A point a, read from the clock (point b); kwartieren and five minutes are groep 4-5 content.

2:calendar.why: KD51: 'aanduidingen van tijd en tijdsindeling te hanteren' (reading the kalender); counting days and weeks between dates is calculating with 'tijd' and its units (K11.A points a and e).

2:flat-or-solid.why: Flat versus solid is a property of 'meetkundige figuren' (K14.A point a) and touches point d, the relation between two- and three-dimensional figures.

2:solids-in-real-life.why: Naming bol, kubus, cilinder, kegel, balk and piramide and finding them in objects: 'meetkundige figuren en begrippen' (K14.A point a).

2:3d-faces-edges-vertices.why: Vlakken, ribben and hoekpunten are 'eigenschappen van meetkundige figuren' (K14.A point a), read from a drawing of a solid (point d).

2:add-with-blocks.why: 'Optellen' with gehele getallen (K10.A point a) with a block model; to 1000 is groep 5 in Dutch schools.

2:subtract-with-blocks.why: 'Aftrekken' with gehele getallen (K10.A point a) with a block model; to 1000 is groep 5 in Dutch schools.

2:column-method.why: K10.A points d and e: 'schriftelijk rekenen' with 'standaardprocedures' (cijferen); Dutch schools reach this in groep 5-6, after rijgen and kolomsgewijs rekenen.

2:shopping-money.why: 'Geld' in K11.A point a; K18.A points a and c: numbers 'in concrete, voor de leerling relevante situaties' and 'wiskunde gebruiken bij het nemen van beslissingen' (is there enough money); the sums are K10.A.

2:bar-graphs.why: K12.A point c: 'maken van grafische representaties van data en daaruit conclusies trekken' (staafdiagram from a turftabel).

2:line-plots.why: K12.A point d: 'interpreteren van grafische representaties'; a line plot is a simple diagram of data (the form itself is little used in Dutch methods).

2:round-to-ten.why: Afronden op tientallen is the base technique of 'schattend rekenen' (K10.A point d) and uses ordering on the number line (point a).

2:mass-grams.why: K11.A points a and b: 'gewicht (massa)' and 'meten met passende meetinstrumenten'; reading the scale is K16.B points c and d ('bepalen, interpreteren … van het resultaat').

2:read-jugs.why: 'Inhoud' in K11.A point a, read from a maatbeker (point b; K16.B point c 'gebruiken van een instrument').

2:choose-units.why: K11.A points d and e: 'referentiematen' and 'relaties leggen tussen grootheden en eenheden' — which unit fits what is measured; only the metric pairs (cm/m, g/kg, ml/l) exist in Dutch schools.

2:equal-groups-times.why: 'Vermenigvuldigen' (K10.A point a) introduced from equal groups and herhaald optellen, as in groep 4.

2:arrays.why: The rechthoekmodel (rows × columns) for 'vermenigvuldigen' (K10.A point a).

2:skip-count-3-4.why: The rows of 3 and 4 are the 'tafels van vermenigvuldiging' in the making (K10.A point b) and 'patronen in rijen getallen' (K13.A point a).

2:scaled-pictograph.why: K12.A points c and d: making and interpreting a beelddiagram where one picture stands for 2.

2:share-and-group.why: Eerlijk verdelen and making equal groups with objects is the idea of 'delen' (K10.A point a) before the division sum; the skill line itself calls it readiness.

2:equal-shares-shapes.why: K10.B point a: 'stambreuken' — halves, thirds and fourths of a shape and the fraction that belongs to a picture; Dutch schools write fractions formally from groep 6, groep 4-5 say 'de helft', 'een kwart'.

2:fraction-of-a-set.why: K10.B points c and e: 'relaties leggen tussen breuken en delingen' and 'rekenen met breuken in concrete situaties, ondersteund met een model' (1/3 of a set of pictures).

2:symmetry-line.why: K14.A point e: 'spiegelen'; judging whether a line is a spiegellijn is reasoning about that transformation.

2:symmetry-complete.why: K14.A: 'voert meetkundige transformaties uit', point e 'spiegelen' — the child draws the mirrored half.

2:grid-coordinates.why: K14.A: 'plaatsbepalingen' — a square found by its letter-number code (B2), as on a plattegrond (point c).

2:tangram-orientation.why: Rejecting turned or flipped figures is reasoning about 'draaien, spiegelen' (K14.A point e).

3:compare-4-digit.why: K10.A point a: 'vergelijken, ordenen' of gehele getallen; to 10 000 is groep 5-6 content.

3:rounding.why: Afronden op tientallen en honderdtallen is the technique of 'schattend rekenen' (K10.A point d).

3:column-regrouping.why: K10.A points d and e: 'schriftelijk rekenen' with 'standaardprocedures'; in Dutch schools cijferend optellen/aftrekken sits in groep 5-6.

3:estimate-by-rounding.why: K10.A point d: 'schattend rekenen', and point c: 'reflecteren op de keuze en uitvoering' (is the exact answer reasonable).

3:magic-squares.why: Sums with gehele getallen (K10.A) in a puzzle that needs an approach of its own: K15.A point a 'een aanpak voor een niet-routinematig oplosbaar probleem'.

3:parity-of-sums.why: K10.A point e: 'rekenen met eigenschappen van getallen en bewerkingen' — even + oneven = oneven, reasoned without adding.

3:arithmetic-patterns.why: K13.A point a: 'herkennen, beschrijven en voortzetten van patronen in rijen getallen'; the steps of 25, 50, 100 are sums of K10.A.

3:time-to-minute.why: 'Tijd' in K11.A point a, read from the analog clock to the minute (point b).

3:mult-equal-groups.why: 'Vermenigvuldigen' (K10.A point a) as equal groups or a rectangle.

3:mult-number-line.why: 'Vermenigvuldigen' as equal jumps; the multiples are the 'tafels van vermenigvuldiging' (K10.A points a and b).

3:commutative.why: The omkeereigenschap is one of the 'eigenschappen van … bewerkingen' of K10.A point e.

3:times-tables.why: K10.A point b names it: 'memoriseren van … de tafels van vermenigvuldiging, en deze kennis vlot en wendbaar toepassen' (in Dutch schools the tables 1-10 are groep 4-5).

3:scaled-graphs.why: K12.A points c, d and e: making and interpreting 'diagrammen' with a scale of 2, 5 or 10.

3:thermometer.why: 'Temperatuur' is named in K11.A point a; reading the scale of the thermometer is 'meten met passende meetinstrumenten' (point b) and K16.B point c.

3:division-sharing.why: 'Delen' (K10.A point a) as verdelen over a given number of groups.

3:division-repeated-subtraction.why: 'Delen' (K10.A point a) as opdelen: how many equal jumps back to 0.

3:mult-div-relationship.why: Division from the tables: 'getalrelaties' and 'eigenschappen van … bewerkingen' (K10.A points b and e).

3:muldiv-word-problems.why: K15.A: 'lost … toepassings-problemen op'; choosing between verdelen and opdelen is the modelling, the sums are vermenigvuldigen/delen (K10.A).

3:input-output.why: K13.A: 'redeneert over patronen en verbanden' — finding the rule between in and out (point c: a verband shown in a table); applying it is a sum of K10.A.

3:balance-equations.why: The is-teken as 'the same amount on both sides' is K16.A point a ('wiskundige symbolen, notaties en begrippen'); finding the number is K10.A.

3:add-subtract-time.why: K11.A: 'rekent met grootheden en bijpassende eenheden', 'tijd' (point a), minutes and hours (point e).

3:elapsed-duration.why: Calculating a tijdsduur between two clock times: K11.A 'rekent met grootheden', 'tijd'.

3:time-12-24.why: Two notations of 'tijd' (K11.A point a, relations of point e); the 24-hour notation is everyday in the Netherlands.

3:area-model.why: K11.A point c: 'bepalen van omtrek, oppervlakte en inhoud van rechthoekige figuren' — area as rows × columns.

3:same-area.why: K11.A point c: 'oppervlakte … van rechthoekige figuren', reasoned over rectangles of different shape.

3:same-perimeter.why: K11.A points c and e: omtrek and oppervlakte and the relation 'tussen grootheden onderling'.

3:division-remainder.why: 'Delen' with a rest (K10.A point a); Dutch schools treat it in groep 5.

3:right-angles.why: The rechte hoek is one of the 'meetkundige … begrippen' and a property of figures (K14.A point a); angles are groep 6-7 content in Dutch methods.

3:classify-quadrilaterals.why: K14.A point a: 'redeneren met en over eigenschappen van meetkundige figuren' (a vierkant is also a rechthoek).

3:symmetry.why: Spiegellijnen: K14.A point e 'spiegelen' and point a (a property of the figure).

3:partition-equal-areas.why: K10.B point a: 'stambreuken' — each of the equal parts named as 1/b.

3:fraction-unit-build.why: K10.B point a: 'stambreuken, echte breuken' — a/b as a times 1/b.

3:whole-from-unit.why: Reasoning with a stambreuk and its whole (K10.B point a; 'redeneert … met breuken').

3:fraction-number-line.why: K10.B: 'breuken als getal' — a fraction as a point on the number line between 0 and 1.

3:compare-fractions.why: K10.B point d: 'beredeneerd ordenen … en vergelijken van breuken'.

3:equivalent-fractions.why: Gelijkwaardige breuken are the base of K10.B point d ('vereenvoudigen en vergelijken van breuken').

3:fraction-of-set.why: K10.B points c and e: fraction and division (1/3 of 12 = 12 : 3), 'in concrete situaties, ondersteund met een model'.

3:line-plot-halves.why: Measuring a length to the half unit (K11.A points a and b) and 'maken van grafische representaties van data' (K12.A point c).

3:volume-cubes.why: 'Inhoud' (K11.A points a and c) counted in cubes; seeing the hidden cubes is K14.A point d: 'interpreteren van tweedimensionale representaties van driedimensionale figuren'.

K:pre-writing-strokes.why: K3.A point d: 'schrijven op letter-, schrift- en tekstniveau met een leesbaar handschrift'; schrijfpatronen are the voorbereidend schrijven before letters.

K:all-about-me-personal.why: KD54: 'beelden … te gebruiken om er gevoelens en ervaringen mee uit te drukken' (self-portrait, favourite things); for K3.B point b ('verwoorden van eigen ideeën, … ervaringen') the drawing comes before the words.

K:rhyme.why: Hearing rhyme is fonologisch bewustzijn, readiness for reading (K2.A point a 'vloeiend lezen'); K9.B point b names 'rijm en ritme' but as naming features of literary genres, which comes later.

K:category-sort.why: Sorting pictures by category builds the 'woordenschat … en kennis van de wereld' that K2.A point b uses for understanding texts; kleuter readiness, no text yet.

K:letter-identification.why: Telling b/d/p/q apart is letter knowledge before reading (K2.A point a 'aandachtig vloeiend lezen').

K:letter-formation.why: K3.A point d: 'schrijven op letter-… niveau met een leesbaar handschrift'; Dutch schools teach the letter forms in groep 3 and the capitals later.

K:count-syllables.why: Klappen van lettergrepen is fonologisch bewustzijn before reading (K2.A) and a first look at 'klemtoon … en ritme' of words (K6.A point a), not yet tied to meaning or spelling.

K:letter-case.why: Matching hoofdletter and kleine letter is letter knowledge before reading (K2.A point a).

K:beginning-sounds.why: Hearing the beginklank and tying it to a letter is fonemisch bewustzijn before 'vloeiend lezen' (K2.A point a); K6.A point a ('verkennen hoe letterklanken … samenhangen met de betekenis') is touched by the m-or-n contrast only.

K:category-odd-one-out.why: Which one does not belong is category knowledge: 'woordenschat … en kennis van de wereld' (K2.A point b) with pictures, before texts.

K:opposites.why: Tegenstellingen with pictures widen the 'woordenschat' of K2.A point b; with pictures only it is readiness.

K:alphabet-order.why: The order of the alphabet is letter knowledge (before K2.A) and the condition for 'inzetten van hulpmiddelen en bronnen' such as a woordenboek (K6.B point e).

K:story-sequencing.why: Ordering story pictures is the step before K9.A point a ('hoe het verhaal zich ontwikkelt') and before 'tekststructuren' in K2.A point c; no text is read yet.

K:sound-position.why: Hearing a sound at the beginning, middle or end is the auditory analysis before reading (K2.A) and before spelling (K6.B).

K:vowels-consonants.why: Klinker and medeklinker are the 'taalkundige begrippen' of K6.A point e ('bij het denken en praten over spelling'); Dutch schools introduce them in groep 3-4.

K:bilingual-cards.why: Two languages side by side on a word card is the step before K7.B point c ('overeenkomsten en verschillen tussen het Nederlands en andere talen … op … woord… niveau') and widens woordenschat (K2.A point b).

K:segment-phonemes.why: Hakken in klanken (with tweetekenklanken in one box) is the auditory analysis on which spelling (K6.B) and decoding (K2.A point a) rest.

K:cvc-build.why: Building mkm-woorden from letters is the first klankzuivere spelling (K6.B: 'regels en procedures voor spelling', point c spellingbewustzijn); in the Netherlands this is groep 3.

K:word-picture-match.why: Reading a word and tying it to its meaning is K2.A (point a 'lezen', point b 'woordenschat') at the first level; in the Netherlands groep 3.

K:singular-plural.why: K6.A point b: 'inzicht tonen in de opbouw van basale woorden om de betekenis af te leiden' — enkelvoud and meervoud.

K:digraphs-k.why: Hearing one sound written with two letters at the start of a word (Dutch: sch, ch, and the tweetekenklanken oe, ie, eu, ui) is readiness for reading (K2.A point a); sh/th do not exist in Dutch.

K:sight-words-reading.why: Reading hoogfrequente woorden at sight, alone and in sentences, is the road to 'aandachtig vloeiend lezen' (K2.A point a); in the Netherlands groep 3.

K:word-sentence-tracing.why: K3.A point d: 'schrijven op letter-, schrift- en tekstniveau met een leesbaar handschrift' — words and short sentences with spaces.

K:articles.why: De or het with a noun is K6.B point a: 'correct formuleren op woord-… niveau'.

1:rhyming.why: Finishing and making rhymes is K3.B point c: 'experimenteren met klanken, woorden'; K9.B point b ('rijm en ritme' as a genre feature) comes later.

1:phoneme-boxes.why: Hakken en plakken is the core of aanvankelijk lezen (towards 'vloeiend lezen', K2.A point a) and of klankzuivere spelling (K6.B) in groep 3; the new kerndoelen do not name it apart.

1:digraphs.why: Letter teams for one sound are read (K2.A point a) and written (K6.B, spelling); the Dutch counterpart is ch, sch, ng, nk and the tweetekenklanken — sh and th are not Dutch.

1:spell-picture-words.why: K6.B: 'regels en procedures voor spelling', point c 'ontwikkelen van spellingbewustzijn'.

1:syllables-split.why: Reading and building words by lettergrepen is groep-3 reading (K2.A point a); the klankgroepen are the base for the spelling rules of groep 4 (K6.B).

1:syllable-vowel.why: Klinker and lettergreep used as 'taalkundige begrippen … bij het denken en praten over spelling' (K6.A point e); it prepares the open/gesloten-lettergreep rule (K6.B).

1:word-families-syllable-reading.why: Decoding words and finding their meaning (picture): K2.A point a 'vloeiend lezen' at groep-3 level.

1:alphabetical-order.why: ABC order by first and second letter is what K6.B point e ('inzetten van hulpmiddelen en bronnen', the woordenboek) needs; the wording does not name it.

1:opposites.why: K2.A point b: 'inzetten en uitbreiden van woordenschat' — tegenstellingen read, written and used in a sentence.

1:articles.why: De-woorden and het-woorden: 'correct formuleren op woord-… niveau' (K6.B point a), with the begrip lidwoord (K6.A point e).

1:read-and-follow.why: K2.A: 'toont begrip van … teksten' — the child shows understanding of a sentence by doing what it says (point a, aandachtig lezen).

1:cloze.why: Choosing the word that fits the sentence shows understanding and uses woordenschat (K2.A points a and b).

1:synonyms.why: K2.A point b: 'inzetten en uitbreiden van woordenschat' — two words for one meaning.

1:unscramble-sentence.why: K6.A point c: 'hoe woordvolgorde … de betekenis van een zin bepalen'; hoofdletter and punt are K6.B ('interpunctie', 'correct formuleren op … zinsniveau').

1:question-words.why: Matching a wie/wat/waar question to its answer is understanding sentences (K2.A); it prepares K6.A point c (which zinsdeel answers which question).

1:story-sequencing.why: Ordering sentences of a story uses 'tekststructuren' (K2.A point c); K9.A point a asks to describe 'hoe het verhaal zich ontwikkelt', for which ordering is the step before.

1:word-classes.why: K6.A point e: 'functioneel gebruiken van taalkundige begrippen' (zelfstandig naamwoord, werkwoord, bijvoeglijk naamwoord); Dutch methods start this in groep 4-5.

1:pronouns.why: Replacing a name by hij/zij/ze: a taalkundig begrip in use (K6.A point e) and 'correct formuleren op woord-, zins-… niveau' (K6.B point a).

1:shades-of-meaning.why: Ordering words from weak to strong widens woordenschat (K2.A point b) and is K6.A point d: 'verkennen hoe woordgebruik … de betekenis beïnvloeden'.

1:root-words.why: K6.A point b: 'inzicht tonen in de opbouw van basale woorden om de betekenis af te leiden'.

1:story-writing.why: K3.A points a and c: an approach (story map) and 'tekstsoorten' (story, postcard); K3.B point b: 'verwoorden van eigen ideeën, … ervaringen, … fantasieën'.

2:digraphs.why: Spotting a letter team in sentences is 'ontwikkelen van spellingbewustzijn' (K6.B point c); in Dutch the pattern would be sch, ch, ng or a tweetekenklank, not sh.

2:sentence-boundaries.why: K6.B: 'regels en procedures voor spelling, formulering en interpunctie' — hoofdletter, punt, vraagteken, sentence limits.

2:cursive-writing.why: K3.A point d: 'schrijven op letter-, schrift-… niveau met een leesbaar handschrift'; Dutch schools that teach verbonden schrift do so from groep 3.

2:cloze-context.why: Using the context of a story to find a word: K2.A points b and f ('begripsverhogende strategieën').

2:question-words.why: Finding the question that asks for a marked answer is understanding the sentence (K2.A) and the step before K6.A point c ('hoe woordvolgorde en zinsdelen de betekenis van een zin bepalen').

2:read-and-answer.why: K2.A: 'toont begrip van … literaire teksten', point e (meaning of the text); who/where/when are K9.A points b and d ('waar, wanneer … een verhaal zich afspeelt').

2:describe-a-picture.why: Writing sentences for a reader about a picture (K3.A, point d 'schrijven op … tekstniveau') and 'correct formuleren op … zinsniveau' (K6.B point a).

2:word-classes.why: K6.A point e: 'taalkundige begrippen' — zelfstandig naamwoord, werkwoord, bijvoeglijk naamwoord (groep 4-5 in Dutch methods).

2:plural-nouns.why: Writing the meervoud (-en, -s, -'s, with doubling or single vowel) is a spelling rule (K6.B) built on 'de opbouw van basale woorden' (K6.A point b).

2:spelling-rules.why: K6.B: 'inzicht in regels en procedures voor spelling'; the English patterns have Dutch counterparts of the same kind (open/gesloten lettergreep, ei/ij, au/ou, -d/-t by lengthening, meervoud).

2:synonyms.why: Synoniemen widen woordenschat (K2.A point b); choosing another word for 'zei' is K6.A point d: 'hoe woordgebruik … de betekenis beïnvloeden'.

2:synonyms~doing-stage.why: Same content as 2:synonyms: woordenschat (K2.A point b) and the effect of word choice (K6.A point d).

2:verb-forms.why: Choosing the right verb form is 'correct formuleren op woord-, zins-… niveau' (K6.B point a); finding the werkwoord and naming tegenwoordige/verleden tijd uses the begrippen of K6.A point e.

2:pronouns.why: Linking a verwijswoord to its name is a begripsstrategie (K2.A point f) and uses the begrip voornaamwoord (K6.A point e).

2:read-cursive.why: Reading words in verbonden schrift is technical reading (K2.A point a); the wording does not name script types.

2:compound-words.why: Samenstellingen: K6.A point b ('opbouw van … woorden om de betekenis af te leiden') and K6.B point b ('verbinden van vorm en betekenis om de correcte spelling te achterhalen', the tussen-n and tussen-s).

2:root-words.why: K6.A point b: the shared stam shows 'de opbouw van basale woorden'.

2:prefixes.why: K6.A point b: a voorvoegsel changes the meaning (Dutch: on-, her-, ver-, be-, ont-).

2:retell-with-starters.why: Writing a retelling in order with signaalwoorden (Eerst, Daarna, Toen, Tot slot) is K3.A point c ('tekststructuren'); it prepares K9.A point a ('hoe het verhaal zich ontwikkelt').

2:mystery-animal.why: Reading clues and combining them shows understanding of a short zakelijke tekst (K2.A points b and e); telling animals apart by features supports KD40 ('dieren onderscheiden en benoemen').

2:animal-fact-file.why: K3.C point c: 'ordenen van … kennis in een tekst of schema'; the facts are KD40 ('hoe ze functioneren in hun leefomgeving': food, home) and KD41 ('bouw van … dieren': body covering).

2:compare-two-animals.why: Ordering same and different facts in a schema (K3.C point c) about animals (KD40); it is the step before K2.B point b ('verschillen en overeenkomsten in feiten' between texts).

3:cursive-sentences.why: K3.A point d: 'schrijven op letter-, schrift- en tekstniveau met een leesbaar handschrift'.

3:word-fields.why: Woordvelden widen woordenschat (K2.A point b); telling close words apart is K6.A point d ('hoe woordgebruik … de betekenis beïnvloeden').

3:person-words.why: K6.A point b: word build with an achtervoegsel (bakken → bakker) 'om de betekenis af te leiden'.

3:root-words-in-context.why: The stam and its family forms (K6.A point b), chosen so that the sentence is right: 'correct formuleren op woord-, zins-… niveau' (K6.B point a).

K:human-body.why: KD41: 'de bouw van … mensen en … de vorm en functie van hun onderdelen'.

K:living-nonliving.why: Living versus non-living is the distinction before KD40 ('planten en dieren onderscheiden en benoemen'); the wording does not name it.

K:fruit-vegetable.why: Which part of the plant we eat is KD41 ('bouw van planten … en hun onderdelen'); naming common fruits and vegetables is KD40 ('planten … onderscheiden en benoemen').

K:animal-groups-homes.why: KD40: 'dieren onderscheiden en benoemen en … hoe ze functioneren in hun leefomgeving' (pets, farm, wild; where they live).

K:animal-babies.why: Naming animals and their young is KD40 ('onderscheiden en benoemen'); alike and different between young and parent is a first look at 'de bouw van … dieren' (KD41).

K:seasons.why: The seasons in order are 'tijdsindeling' (KD51); KD46 names 'seizoenen' as a natuurverschijnsel caused by the position of the earth — the sheets describe the seasons, not the cause.

K:day-night.why: KD46 names 'dag-/nachtritme' but as a consequence of 'de positie van de aarde ten opzichte van de zon'; kleuters only describe day and night.

K:weather-temperature.why: KD43: 'weer … beschrijven met behulp van temperatuur, neerslag en wind' (symbols, a week of weather); cold/warm/hot on a thermometer comes before measuring 'temperatuur' (K11.A point a).

K:natural-made.why: Natural or made by people is the first distinction before KD44 ('bij producten uit hun eigen omgeving relaties te leggen tussen de werking, de vorm en het materiaalgebruik').

K:five-senses.why: KD41: 'vorm en functie van hun onderdelen' — which body part (zintuig) serves which experience.

K:recycling.why: KD39: 'met zorg om te gaan met het milieu' — afval scheiden.

K:plant-needs.why: KD40: 'hoe ze functioneren in hun leefomgeving' — a plant needs water and light.

K:sink-float.why: KD42 asks 'onderzoek doen aan materialen en natuurkundige verschijnselen'; sorting pictures into drijven and zinken on paper is knowledge before the investigation.

1:animal-classes-coverings.why: Grouping animals is KD40 ('dieren onderscheiden en benoemen'); by fur, feathers or scales is KD41 ('de bouw van … dieren').

1:habitats-needs.why: KD40: 'hoe ze functioneren in hun leefomgeving' — where animals live, what they eat and need.

1:life-cycles.why: How an animal or plant grows and reproduces belongs to 'hoe ze functioneren' in KD40; the wording does not name levenscyclus separately.

1:sink-float.why: KD42: 'onderzoek doen aan materialen en natuurkundige verschijnselen, zoals … kracht' — the sheet is the predict-and-test record of a drijven/zinken experiment.

1:five-senses.why: KD41: 'vorm en functie van hun onderdelen' — the zintuigen and what each is for.

1:weather.why: KD43: 'hoe je weer … kunt beschrijven met behulp van temperatuur, neerslag en wind' — symbols and a weekly forecast.

1:materials-recycling.why: KD44: 'bij producten uit hun eigen omgeving … het materiaalgebruik'; what I recycle is KD39 ('zorg … voor het milieu').

1:plant-parts.why: KD41: 'de bouw van planten … en de vorm en functie van hun onderdelen' (wortel, stengel, blad, bloem).

1:sun-earth-moon.why: KD46 is about 'de positie van de aarde ten opzichte van de zon' and its effects; facts about sun, earth and moon are the knowledge before, and the moon is not named in the wording.

2:materials.why: KD44: 'het materiaalgebruik' of everyday products; grouping them for recycling is KD39 (milieu).

2:plant-parts.why: KD41: 'bouw van planten … vorm en functie van hun onderdelen', with the part we eat.

2:life-cycles.why: The development from young stage to adult animal is part of 'hoe ze functioneren' (KD40); levenscyclus is not named separately.

2:moon-phases.why: KD46 gives 'natuurverschijnselen zoals seizoenen en dag-/nachtritme' from the position of earth and sun; the schijngestalten of the moon lie on the same line but are not named — in Dutch schools groep 6-8 content.

2:day-and-night.why: KD46 word for word: 'dat de positie van de aarde ten opzichte van de zon leidt tot … dag-/nachtritme'.

2:habitats-adaptations.why: KD40: plants and animals 'in hun leefomgeving'; the body feature that helps is KD41 ('vorm en functie van hun onderdelen').

2:sink-float.why: KD42: 'onderzoek doen aan materialen en natuurkundige verschijnselen' — predict, test, and the effect of shape (the clay boat).

3:water-cycle.why: KD43 asks to describe weather with 'temperatuur, neerslag en wind'; the waterkringloop explains where neerslag comes from, a step further. Verdampen and condenseren are 'natuurkundige verschijnselen' (KD42), here named, not investigated.

3:flower-parts.why: KD41: 'bouw van planten … vorm en functie van hun onderdelen' (meeldraad, stamper, kroonblad).

3:life-cycles-compare.why: Comparing how butterfly and frog develop is 'hoe ze functioneren' (KD40).

3:planets.why: KD46 stays with earth and sun; the order and kinds of the planets go beyond it on the same line (zonnestelsel, groep 7-8 in Dutch schools).

3:investigation.why: KD42: 'De leerlingen leren onderzoek doen aan materialen en natuurkundige verschijnselen' — predict, test, record, conclude.

K:birds-eye-view.why: Side view against top view is K14.A point d ('relaties leggen tussen twee- en driedimensionale representaties') and the idea of a plattegrond (point c); it comes before 'omgaan met kaart en atlas' (KD50).

K:family.why: No kerndoel in PART 2 names the family; the family words are 'woordenschat … en kennis van de wereld' (K2.A point b) at kleuter level. KD34-KD39 do not fit by their wording.

K:transport-flying.why: KD47 looks at the own surroundings 'vanuit de perspectieven … verkeer'; sorting vehicles by land, water and air is first knowledge for that, far from the comparison the kerndoel asks.

K:wants-needs.why: KD35: 'zich redzaam te gedragen … als consument'; telling what you need from what you want is the first step.

K:community-helpers.why: KD47 names the perspective 'werken' in 'de eigen omgeving'; knowing the jobs of the neighbourhood and their tools is first knowledge for it.

1:map-key.why: KD50: 'leren omgaan met kaart' — the legenda; K14.A point c: 'interpreteren van plattegronden'.

1:family-generations.why: Ordering generations from oldest to youngest and a stamboom of the own family is a first step to 'aanduidingen van tijd' and simple sources of the own past (KD51); filling the tree from written clues is reading with understanding (K2.A).

2:cardinal-directions.why: KD50: 'omgaan met kaart en atlas' — the windrichtingen on a map; K14.A: 'plaatsbepalingen', point c 'routebeschrijvingen'.

2:continents.why: KD50: 'de basistopografie van Nederland, Europa en de rest van de wereld'; the werelddelen come in groep 7-8 in Dutch schools, after Nederland and Europa.

2:family-relationships.why: Solving riddles about tante, neef, oma is reading with understanding and woordenschat (K2.A points b and e); no KD kerndoel names family relations.

3:continents-oceans.why: KD50: 'basistopografie van … de rest van de wereld' and 'een eigentijds geografisch wereldbeeld'.

K:healthy-food.why: KD34: 'zorg te dragen voor de lichamelijke … gezondheid van henzelf' — healthy eating.

K:hygiene-habits.why: KD34: 'zorg te dragen voor de lichamelijke … gezondheid' — handen wassen, tanden poetsen.

K:road-safety.why: KD35: 'zich redzaam te gedragen … als verkeersdeelnemer' — the traffic light and crossing the road.

1:food-groups.why: KD34 (lichamelijke gezondheid); Dutch schools use the Schijf van Vijf with five vakken, not four food groups.

1:healthy-habits.why: KD34: 'zorg te dragen voor de lichamelijke … gezondheid van henzelf en anderen' — teeth, germs, daily habits.

1:road-signs.why: KD35: 'redzaam … als verkeersdeelnemer' — verkeersborden and their meaning.

2:healthy-habits-why.why: KD34: caring for health with the reason for each habit.

2:road-signs.why: KD35: 'redzaam … als verkeersdeelnemer' — kinds of signs (waarschuwing, verbod, aanwijzing) and their use in a situation.

K:how-to-draw.why: KD54: 'beelden … te gebruiken om er gevoelens en ervaringen mee uit te drukken en om er mee te communiceren'; drawing by given steps trains the technique, the expression of the child's own comes after.

1:how-to-draw.why: Following and ordering drawing steps is technique in the service of KD54 ('beelden … te gebruiken om … uit te drukken'), not yet expression of the child's own.

2:drawing.why: Drawing from memory and writing about the own drawing uses 'beelden, taal' to communicate (KD54); the writing is K3.B point b ('verwoorden van eigen ideeën, … ervaringen').

K:same-different-visual.why: Visual discrimination is kleuter readiness for telling letters and words apart (reading, K2.A point a); the wording itself does not name it.

K:mazes.none: A maze is fine-motor and route practice; no kerndoel in PART 2 has wording that fits.
K:mazes.why: K15.A asks for a 'wiskundig' problem and K14.A point c for 'routebeschrijvingen'; following a maze is neither.

K:shadow-closure.why: Matching a figure to its outline or to a part is recognition of form before 'redeneren met en over eigenschappen van meetkundige figuren' (K14.A point a).

K:spot-the-difference.why: Close visual comparison is kleuter readiness for reading (K2.A point a); not named in the wording.

K:matrix-logic.why: Finding the piece that fits a row of one kind is noticing a regularity, the step before K13.A point a ('patronen in rijen … figuren').

K:grid-copy.why: Copying square by square needs the place of each square in the grid, a step before 'plaatsbepalingen' with codes (K14.A).

1:find-the-differences.none: A visual puzzle; in groep 3 it is no longer reading readiness and no wording in PART 2 names it.
1:find-the-differences.why: The mirror variant touches 'spiegelen' (K14.A point e) too lightly to defend a row.

1:mazes.none: Picture mazes: no kerndoel in PART 2 has wording that fits.
1:mazes.why: Finding a way through a drawing is not a 'wiskundig probleem' (K15.A) nor a 'routebeschrijving' (K14.A point c).

1:grid-copy.why: Row/column tracking in a grid is the step before 'plaatsbepalingen' with coordinates (K14.A).

1:picture-analogies.none: Analogies (A is to B as C is to ?) are not named by any kerndoel in PART 2.
1:picture-analogies.why: K13.A is about patterns and verbanden 'in rijen getallen en figuren' and 'datasets'; an analogy between pictures is general reasoning, not that.

1:secret-code.none: Decoding with a key fits no wording in PART 2.
1:secret-code.why: K15.C is about describing and devising 'algoritmes' and K16.A about mathematical symbols; a substitution code for letters is neither.

1:picture-sudoku.why: K15.A points a and b: 'een aanpak voor een niet-routinematig oplosbaar probleem' and 'gebruiken van heuristieken' (exclusion by row, column and box).

1:logic-picture-clues.why: K15.A points a and b: a non-routine problem solved by systematic exclusion (a heuristic).

2:find-differences.why: Only the writing part fits: a sentence about each difference is 'correct formuleren op … zinsniveau' (K6.B point a); the search itself fits no kerndoel.

2:logic-grid.why: K15.A points a, b and d: an approach for a non-routine problem, a heuristic (cross out what cannot be), and checking the solution.

3:two-attribute-sort.why: K12.A points a and e: 'invullen van tabellen bij data' (row × column) and 'diagrammen' (the Venn diagram).

3:two-attribute-sort~logic-cabinet.why: Same content as 3:two-attribute-sort: a table by two attributes and a Venn diagram (K12.A points a and e).

3:logic-grids.why: K15.A points a and b: non-routine problem, heuristic of exclusion.

3:latin-square-sudoku.why: K15.A points a and b: 'een aanpak voor een niet-routinematig oplosbaar probleem', 'heuristieken'.

K:feelings.why: KD34: 'zorg te dragen voor de … psychische gezondheid van henzelf en anderen' — recognising and naming feelings is its content in groep 1-2.

K:measurable-attributes.none: not yet read against this curriculum
K:measurable-attributes.why: The point was added on 2026-11-13 for a lesson of the US school year that the teacher leads without a page; no unit of this language teaches it. Read it against the wording before a lesson of this language stands on it.

2:estimate-lengths.none: not yet read against this curriculum
